summary: An internet radio firmware that joins 2.4 GHz WiFi and plays stations from Radio Garden, with punch-in effects on the keys. It is a proof of concept with known rough edges.
features: Tune by continent, country, place and station on the knobs
16 hold-to-play effects: filters, stutters, tape stop, reverse
A small 4-voice synth to play over the radio
Up to 16 favorites; works as a USB sound card for recording
Plays MP3 and AAC; HLS, MP4 and Ogg streams don't play
2.4 GHz WiFi only; HTTPS certificates are not checked

headings: fm1-radio: an internet radio for the fm-1
